title: Invasion/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Lotus: "The System continues to fall into chaos. Check navigation for active invasions."
- Lotus: "Tenno, the balance of power continues to shift. Navigation is marked with new invasions."
- Lotus: "Navigation has been updated with new invasions. Chaos is spreading."
- Lotus: "Nobody deserves the Infestation. Clear it from this node."
- Lotus: "We must destroy this Infestation before the monsters become entrenched."
- Lotus: "Containment has become impossible. We must destroy this Infestation node by node."
- Lotus: "The Infestation is a threat to all life. We have to wipe it out, even if it means working with other factions."
- Lotus: "Being turned by the Infested is a fate worse than death. Even our enemies don't deserve this."
- Lotus: "The Infestation cannot be allowed to spread."
